#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Vec {
    static constexpr double EPS = 1e-9;
    double x, y;

    Vec(double x_=0, double y_=0) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    Vec add(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }

    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }

    Vec scale(double s) const {
        return Vec(x * s, y * s);
    }

    double dot(const Vec& o) const {
        return x * o.x + y * o.y;
    }

    double mag2() const {
        return dot(*this);
    }

    double mag() const {
        return std::sqrt(mag2());
    }

    Vec unit() const {
        double m = mag();
        if (m < EPS) return Vec(0, 0);
        return scale(1.0 / m);
    }

    Vec rot90() const {
        return Vec(-y, x);
    }

    Vec rot270() const {
        return Vec(y, -x);
    }

    bool equals(const Vec& o) const {
        return eq(x, o.x) && eq(y, o.y);
    }

    static bool eq(double a, double b) {
        return std::abs(a - b) < EPS;
    }

    string toString() const {
        char buf[50];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "(%.2f, %.2f)", x, y);
        return string(buf);
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Vec c;
    double r;

    Circle(const Vec& c_, double r_) : c(c_), r(r_) {}

    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& o) const {
        if (c.equals(o.c)) return {};
        Vec d = o.c.sub(c);
        double dist2 = d.mag2();
        double dist = std::sqrt(dist2);
        if (r + o.r < dist + Vec::EPS || r + dist < o.r + Vec::EPS || o.r + dist < r + Vec::EPS) return {};
        vector<Vec> res;
        if (Vec::eq(r + o.r, dist)) {
            res.push_back(c.add(d.scale(r / dist)));
        } else if (Vec::eq(o.r + dist, r)) {
            res.push_back(c.sub(d.scale(r / dist)));
        } else if (Vec::eq(r + dist, o.r)) {
            res.push_back(c.sub(d.scale(r / dist)));
        } else {
            double d1 = (r * r + dist2 - o.r * o.r) / (2 * dist);
            double h = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, r * r - d1 * d1));
            Vec uDir = d.unit();
            Vec rInt = c.add(uDir.scale(d1).add(uDir.rot90().scale(h)));
            Vec lInt = c.add(uDir.scale(d1).add(uDir.rot270().scale(h)));
            res.push_back(rInt);
            res.push_back(lInt);
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        double x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i] = Circle(Vec(x, y), r);
    }

    vector<Vec> allVertices;
    vector<int> parentIndices(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parentIndices[i] = i;
    int totalCount = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<Vec> newVertices;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> intersections = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (intersections.empty()) continue;
            int a = parentIndices[i] = parentIndices[parentIndices[i]];
            int b = parentIndices[j] = parentIndices[parentIndices[j]];
            parentIndices[a] = b;
            for (const Vec& v : intersections) {
                bool exists = false;
                for (const Vec& e : newVertices) {
                    if (v.equals(e)) {
                        exists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!exists) newVertices.push_back(v);
            }
        }
        totalCount += (int)newVertices.size();
        for (const Vec& v : newVertices) {
            bool found = false;
            for (const Vec& e : allVertices) {
                if (v.equals(e)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) allVertices.push_back(v);
        }
    }

    totalCount -= (int)allVertices.size();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        totalCount += 1 - (int)std::abs((i - parentIndices[i]) > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }

    cout << totalCount << "\n";

    return 0;
}
